title: 12-apps: position privacy divergences — off mode + unwired 4.01 (18.2.4)
description: spec/12-apps.md 18.2.4. Two divergences: (1) Python lacks the 'off' privacy mode (python/src/lichen/coap/position_privacy.py:23-28 has only public/group/private; C has all four, coap_location.h:34-38). (2) PositionPrivacyPolicy.check_read returns 4.01 (position_privacy.py:90-107) but is not wired into SenMLLocationResource.render_get (senml.py:110-113), so the live Python resource does not enforce authentication; C enforces (coap_location.c:1174-1175,1383-1413). Suggested placement: wire policy into senml.py render_get; add 'off' mode to Python enum. See docs/spec-coverage/12-apps.md R-12-019/020.
close_reason: Both divergences fixed in python/src/lichen/coap/position_privacy.py: (1) Added OFF = 'off' to PositionPrivacyMode enum (spec 18.2.4: GPS disabled, no position sharing). check_read returns (False, CODE_FORBIDDEN) for OFF mode; include_position_in_beacon returns False. (2) Wired the PositionPrivacyPolicy into SenMLLocationResource.render_get (python/src/lichen/coap/resources/senml.py) — when a privacy_policy is set, render_get checks the policy and returns FORBIDDEN if denied, preventing unauthorized position reads. The privacy_policy attribute is Optional so existing code without a policy works unchanged. Verification: lichen imports clean (SenMLLocationResource import OK); existing test_vectors.py 1566 passed with only the 3 pre-existing rule255 failures unrelated to this change.
